card.name: Linking words inside proper names and titles
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation inside names, titles and phrases in general web text, such as 'from', 'vs', 'of', ':' and the euro sign. Also partway through some proper names.

modes.label: Linking words in sports or place text
